verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
-OBULAMU bwaffe buno
Bujjudde nnyo-ennaku;
Naye obw'ensi eyo
Bwa ssanyu jjereere.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
N'entalo-eza kaakano
Za ntiisa bulijjo,
-Omulabe waffe-ow'edda
Wa maanyi mangi nnyo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Naye Omubeezi waffe
Asingira ddala;
Era-abamwesiga ye
Be baliwangula.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Fenna kyetunaavanga
Tunyiikira nnyini;
Kubanga tumanyi nti:
Ye-alituwummuza.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
-Ekiseera si kinene
Ekirimu-akabi,
Ne tulyoka tutuuka
Awali Katonda.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Obudde bwe bulikya
Enzikiza n'eggwa,
Yesu Musana gwaffe
Aliba-atwakidde
